ad_set.description: Bundle ad-set settings. Supply its budget when campaign.budget_owner=ad_set; omit that budget otherwise.

continue_from.description: Optional plan_ref of a failed, not-yet-continued Meta bundle in this same account and creation shape, when its partial-result continuation is available. Reuses verified created objects; already-created campaign, ad-set and creative inputs must match the prior plan. Omit for a new bundle; never use to blindly retry an uncertain write.
continue_from.title: Continue From

projection.description: Fixed creation shape: standalone creates only a campaign; image_bundle, carousel_bundle and video_bundle create a campaign, ad set, creative and ad. Select the matching typed branch; this is not an arbitrary operation name.
projection.title: Projection

bid_amount_minor.description: Positive integer in the selected Meta account currency's minor units, not a major-unit amount. Supply only with LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP or COST_CAP.
bid_amount_minor.title: Bid Amount Minor

bid_strategy.description: Defaults to LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP. LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP and COST_CAP require bid_amount_minor; the uncapped strategy forbids it.
bid_strategy.title: Bid Strategy

budget.description: Required for a bundle with ad-set-owned budgeting; omit/null for campaign-owned budgeting. A lifetime budget also requires ad_set.end_time.

end_time.description: Time with a UTC offset; required for a lifetime ad-set budget and later than any supplied start_time.
end_time.title: End Time

start_time.description: Optional start time with a UTC offset; if end_time is also supplied it must be later.
start_time.title: Start Time

targeting.description: Omit/null uses geo_locations.countries=[US]. Supplied targeting is used as given; Meta remains authoritative for permitted targeting and eligibility.

amount_minor.description: Positive integer in the selected Meta account currency's minor units, not a major-unit amount.
amount_minor.title: Amount Minor

adset_budget_sharing.description: Available only for ad-set-owned budgets; must be false with budget_owner=campaign.
adset_budget_sharing.title: Adset Budget Sharing

budget.description: Required only when budget_owner=campaign; omit/null for ad-set-owned budgets.

budget_owner.description: Defaults to ad_set. campaign requires campaign.budget and forbids ad_set.budget and adset_budget_sharing. ad_set forbids campaign.budget; a bundle then requires ad_set.budget.
budget_owner.title: Budget Owner

special_ad_categories.description: Declare the applicable Meta special-ad classifications. This changes classification; it does not grant Meta authorization, certify compliance, or bypass targeting restrictions. NONE means none of the listed classifications applies and cannot be combined with another category. Defaults to [NONE]; supply the applicable categories when that default does not apply. Values must be unique.
special_ad_categories.title: Special Ad Categories
